description:
Confirm v2.0.0 packaging meets the global release contract and the validation rows that depend on packaging. Output is the green/red verdict against N-008 §24 items 8–9, plus a green light to T-010e on RELEASES.md readiness.

In scope (binding):
- Confirm electron-builder targets produce the expected artifacts:
  - Linux: AppImage and .deb (per N-008 §4 — Linux-first; v2.0.0 ships Linux).
  - Windows: Portable.exe and Setup.exe (placeholder per N-008 §4 W1; v2.0.0 documents Windows but does not gate on it).
- Every shipped artifact has a matching .sha256 sidecar per the global rule (cove-screen-recorder-Setup.exe.sha256, cove-screen-recorder.AppImage.sha256, cove-screen-recorder_<version>_amd64.deb.sha256, etc.). Format: standard `sha256sum <file> > <file>.sha256` output. Apply automatically when cutting a release per global rule — do not invent a different format.
- Helper binary ships via Electron extraResources at `process.resourcesPath/helper/cove-replay-engine[.exe]` per N-007 §17. Helper has its OWN .sha256 sidecar; the boot-time check from N-007 §6 reads it.
- VAL-UI-010 (helper sha256 mismatch refuses boot with `helper-binary-tampered` and a blocking modal) green on the packaged build, not just dev.
- VAL-UI-011 (helper protocol-version mismatch refuses boot) green on the packaged build.
- VAL-UI-014 (dependency probe blocks app when required dep missing) green on the packaged build. Linux .deb Depends honoured: pipewire (>= 0.3.x), xdg-desktop-portal (>= 1.18). Portal backend (-gnome / -kde / -wlr) is the user's choice and is NOT a Depends per N-007 §17.
- Windows helper signing wired into the same step as the main exe per N-007 §17.
- Auto-update mechanism unchanged from v1.1.0; sha256 check at boot covers integrity after update.
- RELEASES.md updated with a v2.0.0 entry covering: artifact list, sha256 sidecar policy, Linux Depends list, helper extraResources path, portal backend recommendation, dependency probe behaviour. Use only repo-local instructions per CLAUDE.md repo-boundary rules.

Out of scope (binding):
- Runner harness (T-010a), synthetic loads (T-010b), matrix execution (T-010c).
- package.json version bump, CHANGELOG, tag, push, publish — those belong to T-010e.
- Any Electron / helper source changes beyond what is strictly required to wire the .sha256 sidecar reading and the dependency probe modal (which were already locked in N-007 §6 and §15; this ticket verifies, it does not redesign).
- Any cross-project comparison of packaging workflows. Per CLAUDE.md repo-boundary rule, do NOT borrow from sibling projects.
- Borrowing scripts from outside this repo. If the current repo lacks a defined Windows packaging path, state exactly what is missing (per CLAUDE.md Windows artifact rule) and stop; do not invent one.

Acceptance:
- electron-builder produces Linux AppImage and .deb on the build machine.
- Each shipped artifact has a matching .sha256 sidecar verified against `sha256sum -c`.
- Helper binary present at the expected extraResources path inside the AppImage and inside the .deb payload, with its .sha256 sidecar.
- VAL-UI-010, VAL-UI-011, VAL-UI-014 green against the packaged build (not dev).
- Linux .deb Depends list reviewed against N-007 §17 expectations.
- RELEASES.md has a v2.0.0 entry that captures the above without contradicting CLAUDE.md or the global sha256 rule.
- Output: a packaging-audit report (markdown) listing every artifact, its sha256, and the verification result. Feeds T-010c's §24 items 8–9 and T-010e's go/no-go.

Dependencies:
- Independent of T-010a/b/c. Can run in parallel.
- Output gates T-010e in combination with T-010c's verdict.

No commits, tags, or publishes from this ticket. RELEASES.md edits are documentation only and follow the project rule of no commits without explicit user request.
title: v2.0.0 release: packaging audit (artifacts, sha256 sidecars, Depends, RELEASES.md)
